name: Marcus Delgado
title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer
aboutMe: I'm a cybersecurity engineer with over 8 years of experience protecting enterprise systems, leading incident response operations, and building resilient security architectures. I specialize in threat intelligence, penetration testing, and cloud security — translating complex risks into actionable defenses. Based in Berlin, I've worked across fintech, healthcare, and critical infrastructure sectors, and I'm passionate about making digital systems safer for everyone.

Mentor a team of 4 junior security analysts and coordinate quarterly threat reviews
